text:
elen: Heads-up — planning a node cycle for eu-west-3 GPU pool tonight 00:30–03:00 UTC. Purpose: apply microcode + NV driver rollforward after last week's kernel oops spike. Will do cohorted handoffs to avoid >5% capacity loss at any point.

aj: Do we have an exact node list and cohort sizes? need to confirm backfill and pre-warm caches.

elen: Cohorts of 4 nodes (8xA100 per node) so ~32 GPUs per cohort. Order: rack-3 -> rack-1 -> rack-2. Total pool is 500 GPUs in eu-west-3 so peak impact ~6.4%.

rami: Will enable warmup for prefix cache before draining to reduce cold-start latency. Suggested schedule: cordon+prep (5m) -> drain (10m) -> verify (5m) -> uncordon if failback.

sasha: If drain takes longer we should have fallback routing to hosted small-models regionally. Can we route non-critical traffic to us-east1 burst pool?

elen: yes, routing policy updated: requests flagged with tier!=sla go to fallback-model-small in us-east1 during maintenance. prod-model routes remain pinned; if capacity drops we'll auto-fallback to model-v1-quant on dedicated nodes.

maria: Proposed drain commands (run from maint-runbook):

```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-42
kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
# verify pods rescheduled: kubectl get pods -o wide -l app=llm-serving
```

maria: Also run kv-cache-warm script after pods are scheduled: `./scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --prefix common_prompts --parallel 8`

aj: What about cost for burst to us-east1? we estimated ~$1.8k/hr for reserved on-demand use if we need to spin extra capacity. ops approval needed.

rami: We should avoid that unless the drain overruns. With cohorts and warmup I think we can stay under SLA. Also will monitor p95 latency and qps; set alert at 25% deviation.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: MAINT-2024-4873 — eu-west-3 node cycle, 2024-06-18 00:30–03:00 UTC. Ping @oncall 30m before start.

oncall: ack. I'll be on standby and will escalate to networking if we see cross-region egress spike. please leave snafu playbook open.

elen: Will post a short customer status note if we see >10% increase in error rate. Otherwise we'll add a status summary in the morning. Thanks all — team leads please review runbook and lgtm by 20:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

sasha: lgtm from infra side.

maria: lgtm from runtime. small note: limit concurrent drains to 1 per rack to avoid oversubscription of backfill nodes.

aj: lgtm finance aware — if we need burst I'll approve up to 3 hours.

oncall: I'll join the call at 00:20 UTC.

elen: closing plan. will update MAINT ticket with final node list 30m prior to start.
